preconditions.description: The length of str1 is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The length of str2 is at least 1 and at most 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str1)
preconditions.description: All characters in str1 are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: All characters in str2 are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The returned string is the shortest string that contains both str1 and str2 as subsequences.

postconditions.expression: all(c in return_value for c in str1)
postconditions.description: The returned string contains all characters of str1 as a subsequence.

postconditions.expression: all(c in return_value for c in str2)
postconditions.description: The returned string contains all characters of str2 as a subsequence.
The length of the returned string is the sum of the lengths of str1 and str2 minus the length of the longest common subsequence (LCS) between str1 and str2.
